newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pacific Islands consolidates Fiji mine.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pacific Islands consolidates Fiji mine.

text.p: Pacific Islands Gold NL said on Thursday that early commissioning problems were over at the Mt Kasi gold mine in Fiji.
This followed a 1,377 ounce (dore) pour on Wednesday and a 1,055 ounce (dore) pour last week, it said.
Exploration results from two drill holes at Mt Kasi South indicated the existence of a large mineralised body immediately south of the main ore body, it said.
Results from the two holes which stopped in ore were 20 metres at 4.2 grams per tonne and 10 metres at 4.6 g/t with the last metre assaying 7.0 g/t, it said.
Drilling of the Hillside and Mango breccia pipe zones had increased resources and both zones were still open at depth, the company said.
